integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] A photorealistic dark-fantasy action shot, staged at night on a storm-covered volcanic plain: hard rim light from forked lightning, low violet fill from the glowing ground fissures, volumetric haze, drifting ash and floating embers in the air, wet black basalt underfoot, jagged black ridges on the horizon. The shot begins exactly on Picture 1. A colossal tiger built entirely from storm energy dominates the upper frame - its hide rendered as packed arcs and frayed filaments of white, silver and violet electricity, its eyes burning pale blue, its mane and whiskers streaming sideways as live current, its long tail banded with white light - its head lowered toward the centre of the plain and its jaws parted to show teeth made of light. Directly beneath it, seen from behind and standing at about one tenth of the frame height, a lone fighter in an orange martial-arts gi with a black belt plants his feet on the cracked black rock, arms hanging loose at his sides. The tiger's head alone fills the upper half of the frame.
From 00:00.000 to 00:01.500 the camera holds an almost static shot with a very small push in at slow speed. The tiger's head sinks lower, arcs of electricity crawl slowly across its shoulders, rock dust lifts off the ground and hangs in the air, and the fighter's shoulders rise with one slow breath.
At 00:01.500 the tiger lifts its forepaw with large amplitude at slow speed, the talons unfolding one after another, each one trailing violet arcs that shear off into the haze. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at medium speed toward the tiger's chest, and the sub-bass hum under the storm climbs in pitch.
At 00:03.000 the paw slams down with large amplitude at fast speed. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed and tilts up to keep both figures in frame as the paw drives toward the fighter. Lightning bursts out of the clouds in branching forks and the whole plain is lit to white for a few frames. The fighter drops into a wide horse stance and thrusts both arms straight up, forearms crossing under the falling paw. At the instant the paw meets his hands, around 00:04.200, a hard ring of white light explodes outward from the contact point, the rock under his boots splits into glowing fissures, orange-gold energy erupts from his body and spirals up his arms, sparks spray outward in every direction, and he throws his head back, back bowing, jaw wide open, and shouts <d>[Chinese] 你休想！</d> (S1). His jaw stays open through the shout and then snaps shut.
From 00:05.000 to 00:08.000 the camera eases into a slow arc around the two figures with small amplitude at slow speed and settles. The tiger's paw is held straining a hand's width above the fighter's palms, violet arcs bleeding off the talons into the orange flare wrapped around his arms; sparks rain down, ash drifts across the lens, the light from the cracks in the ground pulses once and steadies, and the final frames lock exactly into Picture 2's composition - the fighter deep in his stance with both arms braced overhead, the blazing fissures spreading outward around him, the tiger's mass filling the sky behind, everything slow and heavy as the shot comes to rest at 00:08.000.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous thunderstorm: long low thunder rolling across the ridges in waves, sharp electrical crackle and buzzing arcs snapping around the tiger's body, a deep chest rumble from the beast, wind hissing over bare rock, gravel and ash ticking against stone, one heavy impact boom with a ringing metallic overtone at the moment of contact, and the steady hiss of falling sparks afterwards.

non_diegetic_music:
A low orchestral bed of contrabass drone, taiko and timpani enters under the thunder at a very slow tempo and holds one sustained note through the stare-down, accelerates into a rapid percussive run as the paw descends, lands a full-brass fortissimo stab at the instant of contact, then cuts away to a single sustained low string note with a slow gong decay for the final hold.
